integrity: Reproduced the exact Fock monomial computation and the Poisson saddle-point estimate; standalone finite checks are supplementary. No independent validation or publication priority certificate.
scientific_limitations: One complex variable; concentric disk; two fixed Gaussian weights. Sharp asymptotic holds for fixed ratio alpha/beta>1 and is not uniform through equality. Ordered singular values are the decreasing rearrangement of the monomial coefficients. Historical priority cannot be guaranteed. The analytic proof, not finite tests, supports the theorem.
title: Sharp Gaussian-weight mismatch in disk-truncated Fock transfer
